clue.text: Lavished compliments on sliced bread and pies

indicators.note: bread that is sliced is cut up, so these letters are cut up and laid out anew

explanation.surface: Someone gushing praise over a spread of sandwiches and pastries.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sliced' rearranges the letters of BREAD and PIES together.
explanation.definitionFit: To praise someone is to heap compliments on them; the old prefixed form is an archaic synonym.

clue.text: Second measures of whisky

parts.note: B is second in grading, as in B-grade or the second team
ells are old measures of cloth length

explanation.surface: A request for another round of whisky measures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'measures of whisky' reads as one phrase, but 'Second measures' is the wordplay and 'whisky' alone defines: Bell's is a Scotch whisky brand.
explanation.definitionFit: Bell's is a well-known brand of blended Scotch, so the brand name stands for the drink itself.

clue.text: A penny? Uproar about taking new income

parts.note: p is the abbreviation for a single penny

indicators.note: taking means the reversed uproar takes in the abbreviation for new
about means the word for uproar is turned round

parts.note: an uproar is a great deal of noise

explanation.surface: A pensioner grumbles that a mere penny rise in income caused an uproar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns NOISE into ESION, and 'taking' puts N inside it after the E.
explanation.definitionFit: A regular retirement payment is a form of income for the person who receives it.

clue.text: A hit record's held at 17

indicators.note: held means the record letter is gripped inside the word for hit

parts.note: to lam is to hit hard, a slangy verb
R is an abbreviation for record

explanation.surface: A chart hit sits held at number seventeen.
explanation.walkthrough: '17' points to the answer at 17-down, WARNING; the surface pretends it is a chart position.
explanation.definitionFit: A loud signal of danger serves as a notice that something bad is on its way, a near synonym.

clue.text: Shoes made hard as nails once hair's been cut

indicators.note: made into something new means the letters are rearranged
once sets the order: the cutting happens first, and only then are the remaining letters remade
been cut means the letters of hair are cut away from the pool before rearranging

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Tough footwear fashioned from nails once someone has had a haircut.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove H, A, I, R from HARD AS NAILS and rearrange the remaining D, A, S, N, A, L, S.
explanation.definitionFit: Open summer footwear held on by straps is one type of shoe.

clue.text: God stifles publicity over Bible's corruption

indicators.note: stifles means the word for god smothers the other pieces inside it

parts.note: a god is a deity

indicators.note: in a down clue over means the first piece sits above the next

parts.note: PR, public relations, is publicity
AV is the Authorised Version of the Bible

explanation.surface: A tale of a deity suppressing scandalous press coverage of scripture.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'over' means above, so publicity comes before the Bible abbreviation; the Authorised Version is the King James Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Moral corruption and wickedness are close synonyms for this state of depraved behaviour.

clue.text: Sport contest involves energy

indicators.note: involves means the word for contest wraps around another piece

parts.note: a war is a contest of arms
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A sporting contest that takes plenty of energy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sport' is a verb here, as in sporting a hat, not a noun for games.
explanation.definitionFit: To sport a garment or badge is to have it on show, to have it on your body.

clue.text: Adore drop of wine or drink, gaining a little happiness

indicators.note: a drop of something is a tiny bit, here the opening letter of wine
gaining means the word for drink takes another letter inside it

parts.note: to sip is to drink

indicators.note: a little of happiness is just its first letter

explanation.surface: A wine lover who adores a drop of wine and gets a little happier with each drink.
explanation.definitionFit: To revere someone with great devotion is to adore them, as a believer does a god.

clue.text: Everything and nothing — animated TV character's linguistic unit

parts.note: all means everything
O is zero, nothing
Morph is the plasticine figure from British children's TV art shows

explanation.surface: A cartoon character who is everything and nothing at once.
explanation.walkthrough: Morph is a small clay-animation character from British children's television.
explanation.definitionFit: In linguistics, this term names one of the variant forms a single morpheme can take, a technical unit of language.

clue.text: Fruit left worker in trouble

indicators.note: in means these pieces go inside the word for trouble

parts.note: pain is trouble, as in taking pains
a worker ant, the crossword's favourite worker

explanation.surface: A fruit picker has been left in difficulty.
explanation.definitionFit: A starchy banana-like fruit eaten cooked, grown across the tropics.

clue.text: Opening of Premier League displayed in perfect colour

indicators.note: displayed in means the letters are shown inside the word for perfect

parts.note: pure means perfect, unblemished

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: The opening day of the Premier League shows a team in perfect colours.
explanation.definitionFit: A mix of red and blue, this is a colour of the spectrum and of royalty.

clue.text: New mood music — missing old CD with heavy metal?

indicators.note: new means the letters are made into a new arrangement
missing means the letters for old and CD are taken out of the pool

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A new mood-music release without the old CD, sounding like heavy metal.
explanation.walkthrough: Take O, C and D out of MOOD MUSIC and rearrange M, O, M, U, S, I.
explanation.definitionFit: A dense blue-grey element, it is the densest naturally occurring metal, so literally heavy.

clue.text: Song about adult with a curse

indicators.note: about means the song word goes round the adult letter

parts.note: an anthem is a song
A is the film-rating abbreviation for adult

explanation.surface: A song about a grown-up, with a curse thrown in.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal ban or condemnation, originally an ecclesiastical curse.

clue.text: Meal of diced red onion when old duck's off

indicators.note: diced food is chopped up, so the letters are reassembled
is off means the letters for old and duck are taken away

parts.note: a duck in cricket is a score of nought, so O

explanation.surface: A recipe: diced red onion, with the old duck left out.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove two Os, one for old and one for duck, from RED ONION and rearrange R, E, D, N, I, N.
explanation.definitionFit: The main meal of the day, eaten at midday or in the evening.

clue.text: I shall smash tree over politician in a bad mood

parts.note: I'll is the contraction of I shall

indicators.note: over means the rearranged tree goes over and around the politician
smash means the letters of tree are broken up

parts.note: MP, Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: Someone in a foul mood vows to smash a tree on top of a politician.
explanation.walkthrough: 'smash' gives TEER from the four letters, which 'over' wraps around the politician. 'in' is only a link before the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Irritability and a short fuse amount to being in a foul humour, a near synonym.

clue.text: They search odd planet gathering germanium

parts.note: rum means odd, strange

indicators.note: gathering means the planet word takes in another piece

parts.note: Mars is a planet
Ge is the chemical symbol for germanium

explanation.surface: A strange planet that gathers germanium.
explanation.definitionFit: People who rummage are those who root about looking for something.

clue.text: Shoes for winter runners?

definitions.meaning: people who skid on ice, humorously runners who lose their footing in winter

explanation.surface: Footwear recommended for joggers in the cold months.
explanation.definitionFit: Indoor house shoes, and also people who slide about on icy pavements.

clue.text: Senior citizen, over 50, chopped wood by hand

indicators.note: over means the chopped wood goes over and around the number
chopped means the letters of wood are cut up and rearranged

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty
a hand is a worker, someone who mans a ship or farm

explanation.surface: A pensioner over fifty chopping wood by hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chopped' gives ODWO, and 'over' wraps it round the Roman fifty; 'by' just places the hand beside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An elderly female pensioner is a senior citizen, an informal and slightly unkind phrase.

clue.text: Advance notice making East trade with West

indicators.note: trade with means one letter is swapped out for another

parts.note: making money is earning it
E is the compass abbreviation for East
W is the compass abbreviation for West

explanation.surface: An early notice that the East is opening up trade with the West.
explanation.walkthrough: 'making' is a noun-like verb here, as in making a living; swap its E for W.
explanation.definitionFit: A notice given beforehand of trouble ahead is a caution, a synonym.

clue.text: Opening numbers by Turkey and Israel

parts.note: TR is the international vehicle registration code for Turkey
IL is the international code for Israel

explanation.surface: Opening fixtures from Turkey and Israel, perhaps in a tournament.
explanation.definitionFit: Each of the two external openings of the nose is a passage for air.

clue.text: Solver, this is not one for boys and girls

parts.note: the solver is addressed as you

indicators.note: not means the letter for one is taken out of the word this

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A setter addresses the solver: this puzzle is not one for children.
explanation.definitionFit: Young people of both sexes are referred to collectively by this plural of a word for young men.

clue.text: Recall an oath? You said wrong answer

indicators.note: said means the word is taken by how it sounds when spoken

parts.note: you sounds like the letter U

indicators.note: wrong means the letters of answer are put in another order

explanation.surface: You blurted out the wrong answer and now must take back your oath.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags a playful definition: to take back a sworn statement.
explanation.definitionFit: To retract or revoke something once sworn, a rare verb for taking back a vow.

clue.text: They're found in fancy theme bars, not hotel

definitions.text: They're found in fancy theme bars, not hotel

indicators.note: fancy as a verb, to imagine, suggests the letters are reimagined in a new order
not means the letter for hotel is excluded from the pool

parts.note: H is Hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Coasters turn up in trendy themed pubs but not in hotels.
explanation.walkthrough: Take H out of THEME BARS and rearrange T, E, M, E, B, A, R, S. The whole clue also describes where you would find them.
explanation.definitionFit: Cardboard drink coasters are found on tables in pubs and themed drinking places.

clue.text: Jack hopes to work for patriarch

parts.note: J is the abbreviation for jack in cards

indicators.note: to work the letters is to set them in motion and rearrange them

explanation.surface: A man called Jack hopes to find a job with the family head.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical son of Jacob is one of the patriarchs of Israel, the founders of its tribes.

clue.text: Might she spin a good yarn?

definitions.text: Might she spin a good yarn?

parts.words: Might she spin a good yarn?
parts.note: spinning a yarn also means telling a tall tale, and the female name makes it a she

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a woman is a good storyteller.
explanation.walkthrough: A spinning jenny was the early multi-spindle spinning frame of the Industrial Revolution.
explanation.definitionFit: The spinning jenny, named with a woman's name, spun thread, literally spinning yarn.

clue.text: Goodness! Shame drug's injected

indicators.note: injected means the drug goes into the word for shame

parts.note: pity means shame, as in what a shame
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: An exclamation of shock that a drug has been injected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Goodness!' looks like an exclamation, but it is a noun meaning virtue.
explanation.definitionFit: Religious devotion and virtue are close in meaning to goodness of character.

clue.text: Promoted team's benefit

parts.note: a promoted team goes up a division
a side is a team

explanation.surface: The advantage a newly promoted football team enjoys.
explanation.definitionFit: The positive aspect of something is its advantage or benefit.

clue.text: Provided case of rosé, entertaining finale with wine

indicators.note: entertaining means the outer letters hold another piece between them
the case of a word is its outer letters

parts.note: a finale is the end
red is wine

explanation.surface: A host supplying a case of rosé and red wine for the grand finale.
explanation.definitionFit: To render a service is to give or supply it, so it is a synonym for provided.

clue.text: It's a bore producing clothes for TV

definitions.meaning: a tedious chore or tiresome thing
the outfits of a transvestite, TV being the abbreviation for one

explanation.surface: Television costume work is tedious.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiresome thing is a nuisance; women's clothing worn by a man is the same word.

clue.text: Informal religious group's friend, possibly Mary

parts.note: the possessive ending of group supplies the letter S
an ally is a friend

indicators.note: possibly signals the letters of Mary could be rearranged into another word

explanation.surface: A churchgoer's friend who might be called Mary.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue words 'group's' do double duty: the definition ends at 'group' and its 's gives S. The name is a casual nickname for the Salvation Army.
explanation.definitionFit: A colloquial nickname for the Salvation Army, the Christian charity organised on military lines.
